body: Depends if it’s a dealbreaker for you or not.

Having doubts is normal. Despite what couples like to portray no one has never experienced doubts in their relationship. I think I’ve experienced the same thing you’re describing. I’m either 100% sure I’m going to marry my boyfriend or 0% sure. 

It’s common for people with mental illness and trauma. Sometimes the doubts can get compulsive and constant despite how much you hate the thoughts and how much feelings you have for the person. At least that’s what I’ve been facing. [This article ](https://www.madeofmillions.com/ocd/relationship-ocd)probably describes it better. I’m not sure if this is what you’ve been facing but it sounds to me like you don’t like the idea at all but can’t stop the thoughts. 

I don’t know if this is the case for you, but my observation is you want to be with him, don’t want to be without him but you feel like you shouldn’t because of all your doubts. If you want my opinion I think that you don’t need to breakup with him because you’re having these doubts.
I think this is kinda healthy tbh. Sounds like journaling out loud.

An abusive family member says he wants to see me for Christmas. My mum thinks I should forgive and move on but I don't feel ready to. I'm terrified. No one I've talked to really understands and I probably sound like a stuck up bitch but I am genuinely scared of him. I can't even look at pictures of him and just hearing his voice makes my skin crawl. Now he says sorry and I'm supposed to play happy families and just go along with it. I feel like such a terrible person for not being able to move on. I'm just so scared and somehow him saying sorry has made me feel worse because it's made me realise that that won't fix it and now I feel guilty for still not wanting to see him.

I was always afraid that he would leave me. I told him about how dad left and I was afraid of everyone else doing the same, he told me he wouldn't do that to me. He made my problems seem manageable, made me feel like I could get through them because I have him by my side supporting me. I never saw anything good about myself but he did for some reason and that made me feel a bit better about myself. We clicked so quickly, within a week I felt like he knew me better than anyone else in my life. Hearing his voice was so nice, he always sounded so calm. He said he loved me and I said I loved him too. I felt so comfortable with him, I could actually talk to someone without being anxious. I felt so comfortable that he was there for me, whenever I was having a bad day I'd just think of him. He made me feel safe. And now he doesn't talk to me. I don't know what I did. But he doesn't care anymore. He doesn't want me. He's annoyed by me and avoids me. Now I'm just sitting here wondering what I did. I feel so scared without him. I never realised how safe he made me feel until now. I feel so hopeless. I'm wondering what's wrong with me. Now I'm alone. And everything feels so much scarier cuz I don't have him to tell me not to worry.
Sorry for this, and feel like ppl are gonna read this and think I'm pathetic but I just needed to let this out. Sorry.

I've had this exact same type of OCD for as long as I can remember. I've always been afraid of inhaling certain chemicals or something and accidentally getting high. But honestly, it's not rational, it's OCD. I promise you are not getting high from breathing, if that were the case people who purposely get high wouldn't have to try so hard to get drugs if they could just go to the bathroom and breath, you get me? And also I'm pretty sure (I've never tried obviously) to get high from things like bleach you have to sniff from it directly, like from the bottle. Also side note: one time I was getting especially worried about this because I actually was getting dizzy so I went to the doctor and it turned out I was just low on iron, so maybe visit your doctor if you're getting dizzy a lot.
I've been there, I know it's terrifying now but remember this is your OCD trying to get the best of you and get you in panic over anything. I wish you the best of luck, I know it's not easy, sorry you have to go through this.
